lighting_shading.note: Soft underwater light creates gentle gradients and a calm, diffuse glow.

value_contrast.note: The warm sand and cork provide good value contrast against the cool blue water.

color_palette.note: Cool blue background contrasts beautifully with the warm orange sand and cork.

composition_hierarchy.note: The diagonal placement of the bottle creates a strong, clear focal point.

shape_proportions.note: Simple, rounded forms make the bottle and scroll instantly readable.

viewpoint_depth.note: Multiple depth layers, from foreground sand to background water, create a sense of space.

edges_linework.note: Clean, soft edges with minimal interior lines give a polished, stylized look.

surface_finish.note: The glass has a soft, translucent quality, while the scroll and cork are matte.

pose_rhythm.note: The static, slightly tilted pose and calm environment create a peaceful mood.

idea.recognition_cue: Bottle with a rolled-up scroll inside
